title: Common Ground Roundtable: The American Dream in 2026
description: A structured, respectful conversation about what the American Dream means today. We'll hear from every corner of the political spectrum, break into small groups, and finish with a word cloud of shared hopes.

agendaItems.title: Welcome & Ground Rules
agendaItems.content:
_Welcome to the Common Ground Lounge!_

* Speak from your own experience
* Listen with curiosity, not to rebut
* One voice at a time - the odometer keeps us honest

agendaItems.title: Setting the Stage: A Short History of the American Dream

agendaItems.question: Is the American Dream more attainable today than it was for your parents' generation?

agendaItems.prompt: In one or two words, what does the American Dream mean to you?

agendaItems.headline: What should our next roundtable topic be?

waitingRoom.introText: Grab a coffee and settle in - we'll open the floor shortly. Tonight's conversation: the American Dream in 2026.

matchingQuestions.question: How would you describe your political leanings?
How often do you talk politics with people who disagree with you?

preEventCta.headline: Before we meet: 2 quick questions
preEventCta.message: Your answers help us seat balanced breakout tables. It takes less than a minute.

surveyQuestions.question: What draws you to this event?
options: I want to understand the other side better
I want to make my own case

statements: The American Dream is still achievable for most people.
Where you are born matters more than how hard you work.
The media makes political disagreements seem worse than they are.

postEventCta.headline: Thanks for joining us!
postEventCta.message: Tell us how it went and grab your seat for next week's roundtable.

surveyQuestions.question: How likely are you to join another Common Ground event?

statements: I heard a perspective tonight that I hadn't seriously considered before.
I felt comfortable sharing my honest opinion.
